snippet.title: VELOCIBLASTER - Official Open Alpha Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Evolution. Takes. Flight. Watch the VELOCIBLASTER trailer for this multiplayer VR flight shooter game as you become a dinosaur and blast away your enemies with high-tech blaster cannons. In VELOCIBLASTER, engage in multiplayer PvP aerial combat using rocket thrusters to fly. Outmaneuver and outwit your velociraptor rivals in intense, fast-paced battles. VELOCIBLASTER will be available on Meta Quest and Steam VR, and an open alpha is available now via the game's official Discord server.
